key_insight: MineValiCoder improves LLM-based code generation by jointly filtering test quality and validating code-test interactions to reduce noisy feedback from stochastic models.
engineering_relevance: It offers a more reliable test-driven workflow for automated software synthesis when only natural-language requirements are available.
method: TCQM filters faulty generated tests via self-validation before using them for code optimization.
Parallel TDD refinement iteratively improves code and samples diverse candidate solutions from validated test feedback.
BiCoTeV uses a bipartite graph to score code-test consistency and select the most reliable final code.
evidence_signal: Across four LLMs and standard benchmarks, MineValiCoder reports strong Pass@1 results, including 96.34% on HumanEval, 87.40% on MBPP, 64.00% on APPS, and 51.33% on LiveCodeBench.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of self-validation and graph-based scoring, which may add computational overhead and still be sensitive to residual test noise.
paper_title: MineValiCoder: Reliable Code Generation with Test Case Quality Mining and Bipartite Graph-Based Mutual Validation
